reason: My problem is one bubbling wall in one bedroom, and for that I will call our painter like we always do; he will scrape it, fix it and use whatever paint he trusts for a few thousand rupees. I am not handing my whole house to a company I have never heard of because of one wall.
objection: I have not heard much about Turbolux; is it as good as Asian Paints or Berger, and will this company even be around in three years to honour that guarantee?
would_change_my_mind: If our own painter told me he has used Turbolux and it holds up in the Kochi monsoon, or if I could see a neighbour's or relative's home they did that still looks good after a monsoon.
